subject.title: Cron Jobs Calendar View for Control UI

question: Should maintainers accept a rebased 24-hour Control UI cron timeline as the first slice, require a broader daily/week calendar design first, or defer the feature?
rationale: The remaining work is a user-visible Control UI product shape decision, and the active implementation candidate is stale, conflicting, and narrower than the full request.

options.title: Request a Fresh or Rebased Timeline PR
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for a current-main implementation that ports the timeline onto ui/src/pages/cron while preserving current cron status, scheduler, i18n, and run-state contracts.

options.title: Define Full Calendar Scope First
options.body: Pause the linked branch until maintainers specify whether daily view, week view, stats, drag-and-drop editing, and validator behavior belong in the same feature.

options.title: Defer Core Calendar View
options.body: Leave the current list/run-history UI as the supported core experience and close or defer the linked implementation after maintainer confirmation.

recommendation.title: Request a Fresh or Rebased Timeline PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for a current-main implementation that ports the timeline onto ui/src/pages/cron while preserving current cron status, scheduler, i18n, and run-state contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Control UI docs and UI ownership history make this the best available product-surface routing candidate, though the current cron page history is shared.
